integrity: Written proof uses principal-circle bundle, exact Gysin sequences and Poincare duality; the standalone checker verifies the Hochster combinatorial input and example algebra only. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Computes integral cohomology groups and selected cup products of the finite diagonal quotients for every integer m >= 2; does not classify their complete homotopy types. Classical general cohomology frameworks cover broader quotient settings and may provide alternative derivations.
title: Torsion cup products in finite diagonal quotients of the pentagonal moment-angle manifold
